result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the bottom navigation bar is visibly broken: the 'Orders' tab renders only a text label with no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile. A minor contrast concern exists in the search field placeholder. Carousel edge clipping and the bottom-cut card were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: In the bottom tab bar, the 'Orders' item has no icon above its label, while Home, Search, and Profile each display an icon. This leaves an empty gap and makes the tab look unfinished/broken and inconsistent with the others.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended Orders icon (e.g., a receipt/bag glyph) in the same size, stroke weight, and inactive gray color as the Search and Profile icons, vertically aligned with them.

issues.description: The search placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a very light gray field, giving low contrast that may be hard to read in bright conditions.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the input background, or darken the field background slightly.
